name: perfumeria-arabe
description: Catálogo de perfumes con pedidos por WhatsApp + panel de administrador. Backend local (SQLite, sin Docker) + frontend React.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix "./server" && npm install --prefix "./web"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix ./server" "npm run dev --prefix ./web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix "./server" && npm run build --prefix "./web"
